body:
# Create: Blahaj Factory

Create: Blahaj Factory adds more compat between Just Blahaj & Create to automate your shark friends! (Also Compatible with Only Blahaj)

**Works with Just Blahaj & Only Blahaj**

Features:

- Adds "Plushie Stuffing" from mixing wool and string.
- Plushie Stuffing can be deployed onto wool to create a Blahaj.
- Crushing your Blahajs! (don't do it)
- Engineer Blahaj (Just a cute plushie currently, will have more features soon.)

Extra Mod Compat:

- Naturalist
- Toasty's Mobs

Planned Features:

- Compat for other mod's plushies like Plushie mod, Plushables, ect.)
- Engineer Blahaj Features
- Blahaj Stock Keeper

Downloads:
- https://modrinth.com/mod/just-blahaj
- https://modrinth.com/mod/only-blahaj
- (**Only Blahaj** _only_ has the classic blahaj, no variants.)
